readme:
# TikTok Batch Video Info (App V3, V2) API

Retrieve detailed information for several TikTok posts at once by supplying a list of video identifiers in the `body` parameter.

## Use cases

- Retrieve metadata for multiple TikTok videos simultaneously.
- Monitor engagement statistics across a catalog of video IDs.
- Enrich internal media databases with bulk video details.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/app-v3/multi-video-v2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"body": "<body>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | array | Yes | Video id list |

## Notes

- Provide video identifiers as an array in the `body` parameter.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
